thread:
Emily_CS: Heads up — AcmeHealth escalated. Their Console shows 0 requests for eu-west region between 2025-03-01 and 2025-03-03 but our ingress logs show traffic and they reported intermittent 500s + latency spikes. Putting details here to triage.

BenP: Thanks. Can you paste exact repro steps / which dashboard + filters?

Emily_CS: Path: Console -> Analytics -> Requests. Filters: Region: eu-west (selected from dropdown), Model: gpt-large-v1, Version: v2025-11-03, Time range: Mar 1 00:00 -> Mar 3 23:59 UTC.
Expected: ~48k requests. UI shows 0 requests, 0 errors. API query we used: GET /console/api/metrics?region=eu-west&model=gpt-large-v1&version=20251103&start=2025-03-01T00:00Z&end=2025-03-03T23:59Z returns: {\"counts\":{\"requests\":0,\"errors\":0}}
But ingress logs (snippet):
```
2025-03-01T08:12:34Z ingress[acmehealth] request_id=abc123 region=eu-west model=gpt-large-v1 version=20251103 status=200 latency_ms=112
2025-03-01T09:01:02Z ingress[acmehealth] request_id=def456 region=eu-west model=gpt-large-v1 version=20251103 status=500 latency_ms=890
```

AlexW: I can take a look. Any chance this is the normalization/config mapping change we rolled 2025-02-28? Noted a change to metrics ingestion to add region_code and model_alias fields.

MariaG: FYI we shipped an index migration on 2025-02-28 that introduced region_code (values like EU-WEST-1) but left legacy region values untouched for backward compatibility. Console filtering expects region slug like `eu-west` though — there might be a mismatch in the translation layer.

BenP: That would explain UI=0 while logs show data. Can you run the low-level query against metrics index for that time range?

MariaG: Running now. SQL-ish query: SELECT count(*) FROM request_metrics WHERE region='eu-west' AND model='gpt-large-v1' AND version='20251103' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-03'; -> 0
But: SELECT count(*) FROM request_metrics WHERE region_code='EU-WEST-1' AND model_alias='gpt-large-v1' AND version_tag='20251103' -> 47,832

Emily_CS: So frontend -> api layer probably sending region=eu-west and not translating to region_code. Customer-facing filter value != stored field.

AlexW: I'll add a quick mapping shim in the query service so region slugs map to region_code and model/version aliases map as well. Will test locally then can hotfix. ETA ~30-45m.

SREbot: Alert: metrics-query-high-latency fired at 2025-03-01T09:05:00Z for metrics-query-svc (p95 2.1s).

BenP: Can we do a scoped patch rather than full rollback of index? We don't want to touch customer data.

MariaG: Agreed. Patch the console->metrics gateway to accept both region and region_code. Also add fallback to search region_code if region lookup returns nothing. I'll craft a tiny migration script to add region slug aliases into a lookup table.

AlexW: Pushed patch to staging and smoke-tested for AcmeHealth filters — counts now match. Patch log: added slug->region_code mapping and model_alias fallback. I'll deploy to prod now (canary on 5% traffic first).

Emily_CS: Notifying AcmeHealth: "We're hotfixing the Console filters now; I expect metrics to populate within 15-30m. Will update when done." :pray:

BenP: Keep threads on response time. If high load persists, we should revert the mapping attempt.

(20 minutes later)

AlexW: Canary went green. Deployed to 100% at 2025-03-01T09:42Z. Metrics gateway now returns counts matching raw index.

MariaG: Verified across a few customers — no other mismatches found in quick sweep. Adding unit tests + an integration test that covers region/model/version pluralities.

Emily_CS: AcmeHealth confirmed: dashboard shows ~48k requests and error spikes; they see latency graphs too. They said "thanks for the quick fix" and will keep monitoring.

BenP: Follow-ups: 1) Add telemetry to catch filter mismatches (GA events), 2) Expand e2e test matrix for console filtering combos, 3) Postmortem + RCA with timeline. I'll open tickets.

Emily_CS: Filing the support ticket update now and will attach thread. Good job everyone. :tada:
